snippet.title: Last State - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Survive the untamed wilderness in a world reclaimed by nature. Hunt, craft and explore across vast procedural landscapes. Build your shelter, master survival skills and forge your path in the ruins of civilization. Every choice matters. Will you thrive or merely survive?

💻 Web: last-state.com

🎮 Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/4275900/Last_State/


The world didn't end with a bang. It ended with a whisper.

Decades after the collapse of civilization, nature has reclaimed the earth. Cities lie buried beneath vines and roots. The old world is gone, swallowed by an endless, untamed wilderness. You are a child of this new world, born into the quiet, raised in the shadow of ruins.

Last State is an immersive text-based survival game where every decision shapes your fate. Explore a massive procedurally generated world spanning forests, mountains, swamps, rivers, and the decaying remnants of human civilization. Master the art of survival through hunting, gathering, crafting, and exploration.


KEY FEATURES


🌲 Vast Procedural World


8 unique biomes: dense forests, open plains, treacherous swamps, mountain peaks, lakeshores, rushing rivers, abandoned ruins and overgrown roads

Dynamic location descriptions bring every area to life

Discover hidden caches, abandoned camps and points of interest


🔥 Deep Survival Mechanics


Monitor hunger, thirst, warmth, fatigue, and hygiene

Build fires to stay warm and cook food

Construct shelters and eventually permanent housing

Weather the seasons from brutal winters to scorching summers

Manage injuries and illness with crafted medicine and bandages


🎯 Hunting & Gathering


Track and hunt different animal species from rabbits to bears and wolves

Fish in rivers and lakes with rods, traps and bait

Gather resources from each biome: mushrooms, berries, herbs, minerals and more

Set snare traps and fish traps for passive food gathering


🛠️ Extensive Crafting System


Craft over 100+ items from primitive tools to advanced equipment

Quality-based crafting: your skills improve with practice

Create weapons: spears, bows, arrows and more

Build structures: shelters, permanent houses, storage containers

Craft survival gear: clothing, armor, medical supplies


🌾 Farming & Settlement Building


Establish farm plots and grow 15 different crops

Plant fruit trees and berry bushes for long-term food security

Build permanent structures with planks, beams, walls and roofing

Create your own refuge in the wilderness


🏴‍☠️ Dynamic Encounters


Meet friendly NPCs who can trade, share information or become companions

Face hostile survivors who seek to take your hard-earned supplies

Defend against wolf attacks and other predatory wildlife

Every encounter is procedurally generated and unique


📈 Progression & Skills


Level up survival skills through practice: crafting, hunting, gathering and exploration

Unlock better success rates and higher quality crafted items

Score system rewards clever play and overcoming challenges

Multiple starting scenarios increase difficulty and replayability


🎨 Immersive Atmosphere


Rich environmental storytelling through detailed descriptions

Atmospheric pixel art visuals showcasing the world's beauty and danger

Dynamic narrative intro that sets the tone for your journey

Text-based interface with modern UI design



Survival is Just the Beginning


In Last State you're not just trying to survive. You're building a new life in a world that's moved on without humanity. Will you become a master hunter, trading pelts and meat? A skilled craftsman, creating tools and weapons? A farmer, cultivating the land? Or an explorer, uncovering the secrets of the old world?

The wilderness is vast. Resources are scarce. Danger lurks in every shadow.


🎮 Perfect For Fans Of


Traditional roguelikes and survival games

Deep crafting and progression systems

Procedural generation and emergent gameplay

Text-based adventures with modern design

Games like Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead, NEO Scavenger, Unreal World and Project Zomboid



Remember: In the wilderness, every choice matters.

Your story begins now.
